snippet.title: Toy Town Mayhem - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Toy Town Mayhem – Official Game Trailer

What is Toy Town Mayhem?
Toy Town Mayhem is an upcoming free-to-play first-person shooter!
Play with up to 9 other real players in Toy Town’s Battle Royale or Free For All modes.

Hang out in colorful, chaotic Toy Town on your Windows PC, Mac, iPhone/iPad, or Android devices – completely free.

Whether you're playing on PC or mobile, Toy Town has a place for you!

Links:
Official Website: https://toytownmayhem.com
Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3898800/Toy_Town_Mayhem/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/toy-town-mayhem/id6748932869
Play Store: Coming soon!

Wishlist on Steam and Pre-Order on the App Store!
